newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA LEV ENDS FIRMER AT 1,590-1,610 PER DOLLAR.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA LEV ENDS FIRMER AT 1,590-1,610 PER DOLLAR.

text.p: The lev closed at 1,590-1,610 per dollar, firmer from the midday's 1,600-1,630 and the morning's 1,660-1,680 as dollar supply topped demand in thin interbank trade, dealers said.
"Trade was very thin and at increasingly weaker dollar rates because of light foreign currency demand," one dealer said.
Supply was higher as exporters were offering dollars to boost lev liquidity amid anticipation of a stable lev.
The market trend in the next few days would depend on final clients' interest in foreign currency purchases, dealers said.
"But a lev rise above 1,580-1,600 is deemed unlikely due to general reluctance for dollar sales below those levels," another dealer said. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
